sources.name: OBA Registered Teams
sources.notes: Rendered in real Chromium (Playwright). The page shell loads (Club/Age Group/Gender filter form + disabled 'Search' button), but the underlying data source is a third-party JSONP API at https://registration.sportsavvy.com/OBA/components/com_sportsavvy/lib/AJAXHandlerPublic.php?cmd=clubs which is BROKEN at the TLS layer: every HTTPS connection (curl, node fetch, openssl s_client, and Chromium itself) gets rejected mid-handshake with 'tlsv1 unrecognized name' / net::ERR_SSL_UNRECOGNIZED_NAME_ALERT -- the server rejects its own hostname as SNI, tried with and without SNI, same result. Plain HTTP to the same host returns a WAF-style 403 'Request forbidden by administrative rules'. Confirmed this is a genuine server-side outage/misconfiguration on OBA's third-party registration vendor (sportsavvy.com), not a bot-challenge or CAPTCHA -- a real browser hits the identical failure. The club dropdown (id=oukey) never populates beyond '[All]' and the Search button stays permanently disabled, so the team table can never render client-side either, confirming this matches the 'nothing to static fetch' symptom reported. No other sportsavvy hostname is referenced anywhere in the page HTML. Recommend re-checking this source periodically in case OBA/sportsavvy fixes their cert; not worth further bypass attempts since it's not a deliberate block.

clubs.name: Over Seas Basketball Association Location 1 (Entire Year)
Over Seas Basketball Association Location 2 (Entire Year)

sources.notes: The page itself renders a Storepoint.co store-locator widget (a third-party map/list finder embed) that shows 'No featured clubs were found in your area' by default because it geofilters on the visiting IP -- it is NOT a login/CAPTCHA gate, just a proximity-search default. The widget's underlying data file is a public, unauthenticated JSON API: https://api.storepoint.co/v1/15d5b06c3617f5/locations (map/account id 15d5b06c3617f5, found embedded in https://cdn.storepoint.co/api/v1/js/15d5b06c3617f5.js which also self-reports STPT_LOC_COUNT=144). A single unauthenticated GET returns all 144 Canada-wide Jr. NBA/Jr. WNBA host-program locations in one response, no pagination, no auth headers needed -- same trick class as the Google My Maps KML export used for OBA's Find-a-Club page. Filtered to the 84 records whose streetaddress is in Ontario, then deduplicated by stripping '(Fall/Winter/Summer/Spring)' season suffixes from the location name (each host runs the same program in multiple seasons, appearing as separate near-duplicate location records with the same address/email) -> 40 unique Ontario host organizations. IMPORTANT CAVEAT: several records carry visible 2019-2020 program dates in their `description` field (e.g. 'Oct 7 - Dec 6, 2019'), so this looks like a locations dataset that has not been fully refreshed since then; treat as 'Jr. NBA-affiliated host orgs on file', not confirmed currently-active programs, and expect some closures/renames since 2020 (e.g. a few entries have obvious address typos like 'Oakvilletario', 'Midlan' for Midland -- vendor data quality issue, not our parsing). All entries are program HOSTS (community centres, YMCAs, existing clubs, municipalities) running a licensed Jr. NBA program, not standalone new clubs -- flagging as a parent-program (Jr. NBA Canada) -> local host-org relationship. Two Toronto Region orgs (Over Seas Basketball Association) run two separate physical locations under one org. Full raw parse saved to docs/research/raw/ontario-research-jrnba-parsed.json.

sources.notes: eobahoops.com (WordPress) itself only publishes a partial 16-name club-representative list on /about (unchanged from prior census). The actual competitive-season standings/rosters live on a TeamSnap Tournaments micro-site linked from eobahoops.com/2025-26-competitive-season: https://events.teamsnap.com/events/45924/results/division. That page IS JS-rendered (an empty 'select a division' shell client-side) but is NOT gated -- rendering it in Playwright surfaced its backing REST API at https://tournaments-api.teamsnap.com/public/events/45924/... . Direct curl to that API gets a Cloudflare 403 UNLESS an Origin: https://events.teamsnap.com and matching Referer header are sent (no cookies/auth/session needed) -- once those two headers are set, plain curl gets a clean 200 with full JSON, no browser required for repeat pulls. Pulled /divisions (33 divisions), /venues (venue list), and critically /participants?lastUpdate=0&updatesOnly=1 (270 rows, one per team-in-division, each with a nested team.name) for the full 2025-26 Eastern Ontario Competitive Season roster. Team names on TeamSnap are inconsistently formatted -- sometimes 'ClubAbbrev - CoachLastName' (e.g. 'OSS - Antoun'), sometimes 'Full Club Brand U## Group - Coach' (e.g. 'Brockville Blazers U14 Boys - Tierney'), sometimes just a bare club/brand token. Deduplicated the 270 team rows down to the ~31 club/brand buckets above by grouping on the shared prefix token; cross-referenced every abbreviation against EOBA's own /about rep list (16 named clubs) and against this repo's existing docs/research/consolidated/clubs-consolidated.csv (independent prior research) wherever possible. Notable finding: this run's evidence indicates 'OSS' and 'OSBA' are likely TWO SEPARATE EOBA member clubs (Ottawa Shooting Stars vs. Ottawa South Basketball Association), whereas a prior census entry had merged them into one club record -- flagged for re-verification, not silently corrected. About half the clubs above (Kanata Selects, Dragons de Gatineau, Arsenal Nouvelles Frontieres, Phenix, FO3, KIBC, Ottawa Elite, Rising Stars, Rockets, Capital X-Men, Arnprior, Overcomers, NBD G-Elite, Mini-Espoirs, plus ICBA which was already independently known) are NOT on EOBA's own /about page at all and were not in the prior 16-club count -- bringing the total distinct club/brand buckets observed to roughly 31, close to EOBA's stated '30 member clubs, spanning from Belleville to Gatineau'. Some of the smaller one-team buckets (Overcomers, NBD G-Elite, Rockets, Arnprior, Capital X-Men) may be single associate/guest teams rather than full standalone clubs -- flagged as uncertain rather than asserted. No login, CAPTCHA, or bot-challenge was bypassed; this is a public read-only sports-league results API.

sources.notes: The bare R180786 short-link redirects to a SportsEngine/TourneyMachine tournament page (Tournament.aspx?IDTournament=h2026050420140144611ffbead9d704f) which DID return a 403/hang to the scripted fetch mentioned in the task, but rendered fine in Playwright with a real desktop User-Agent string set explicitly (default Playwright UA without a UA override was the likely trigger for the earlier block/timeout -- no login, CAPTCHA, or bot-challenge was ever shown; it just needed a normal browser fingerprint and domcontentloaded instead of networkidle, since the page keeps background ad/analytics connections open indefinitely which makes networkidle time out). The tournament root lists 16 division pages (U10 Boys through U16 Boys plus 8 'Championship Weekend' cross-pool divisions). Each division page server-renders a pool-standings table and a schedule with full team names in plain text/HTML -- no separate API call needed, no auth. Visited all 16 division URLs directly and extracted the standings-table team names, yielding 81 team-in-division rows collapsing to 31 distinct club/brand names (excluding 'TBA'/'TBA 1'/'TBA 2' placeholder slots for teams not yet finalized). This upgrades the task's baseline of 3 known clubs (Gators, V3 Basketball, P13 Academy) substantially -- confirmed 'Gators' as 'Gators Elite' and 'V3 Basketball' as active, but did NOT find 'P13 Academy' registered in this particular 2026 spring/summer season (it may play in a different season/division, or not be currently active here -- flagged, not assumed gone). Three clubs cross-confirm against the separate OBA Find-a-Club Google-My-Maps KML export from a different task in this same sweep: YAAACE, Canada Elite, and Downtown Finest/Downtown's Finest -- good corroboration that both sources are capturing real, currently-active Toronto-area clubs. The standout finding is 'GBA', which fields 14+ separately-coached teams across nearly every age division (by far the largest single program in this league by team count) -- its full name is not spelled out anywhere on tourneymachine.com and was not invented; flagged as the top follow-up target. Separately, hoopcitybasketball.leagueapps.com (the org's own LeagueApps front door) rendered fine too but is just a near-empty shell ('Hoop City Basketball League / LeagueApps / Log In / Home / Leagues & Tournaments' -- 72 characters of text) with no club/team data of its own; all real data lives on the TourneyMachine side. All venues are in the GTA/Durham Region (Etobicoke, Ajax, Whitby, Brampton, Unionville, Caledon, Markham, Thornhill, Oshawa) but these are game-venue addresses, not confirmed club home cities, so per-club city was only filled in where independently inferable (e.g. 'Oakville Anchors' from its own name) or already known from prior research -- everything else is honestly marked unconfirmed rather than guessed.

sources.notes: IMPORTANT SCOPE CORRECTION vs. the task's framing: tcbl.ca ('TCBL') is NOT a youth league with a 'J17 Basketball' youth arm in the sense of a multi-club youth directory. Rendered tcbl.ca fully (React app, no gate) -- its own /teams page and backing API (api.tcbl.ca/api/v1/settings/leagueslist) show TCBL is an ADULT recreational pickup/rec basketball league organized into day-of-week leagues (Monday/Tuesday/Wednesday/Thursday/Friday/Saturday/Sunday League, e.g. '2026 Summer Sunday League', 19 skill tiers, 244+ active teams, 3000+ registered players) with joke/pun team names (Malvern, Frieza Force, Sandhurst, 'sexy red's shooters', Osama Bin Pablo, The Hurt Locker, Ankle Broken, Benjeezy B EZ, Fam Goes Ham, Kimchi Adobo, poke, POCKET ROCKETS, etc.) -- these are casual adult rec teams, not youth basketball clubs, and are out of scope for a youth club/team census. Confirmed via the leagueslist API that there is no separate 'J17 Kids' league object anywhere in TCBL's own system. The nav item labelled 'J17 Kids' on tcbl.ca is simply an outbound link to a separate site, https://j17basketball.com/ -- and that site's own footer reads '(c) Toronto Community Basketball League. All Rights Reserved.', confirming J17 Basketball IS operated by the same parent org as TCBL, just under separate branding for the youth side. However, j17basketball.com is a SINGLE basketball facility/club (a training academy in Markham with its own house leagues and 'REP TEAMS'), not a multi-club directory or youth league standings page -- there is no public list of opposing clubs/teams to extract, only J17's own age-group divisions (U9, U10, U11, U12, U13, U14, U15, U17) and program tiers (Little Ballers 5-7, Junior Development 8-10, Skill Builders 11-13, Elite Prep 14-17). J17's rep teams play in 'OBL (Ontario Basketball League)' and a 'Coalition League', plus Ontario Cup or Provincial Championship depending on level -- these are the only cross-references to other real Ontario youth leagues found on the page. No login, CAPTCHA, or bot-challenge encountered on either site; both are plain public marketing/rec-league sites that simply needed real browser rendering (React SPA) rather than a static fetch.

summary:
Investigated 8 JS-rendered Ontario basketball club/team sources with a real Playwright Chromium browser (no login/CAPTCHA bypassed anywhere). Total club/team-brand records extracted across all sources: 152.

1. OBA Registered Teams (basketball.on.ca/competitions/registered-teams/): DEAD, not gated -- the page's own third-party data vendor (registration.sportsavvy.com) is broken at the TLS layer (server rejects its own hostname as SNI) even for a full real browser; confirmed with curl, node fetch, openssl s_client, and Chromium all failing identically. 0 clubs.
2. Jr. NBA Canada find-your-program: PUBLIC. The page's 'no results' message is just an IP-geofilter default, not a gate -- its Storepoint.co widget has a public unauthenticated JSON API returning all 144 Canada-wide host locations in one call. 40 unique Ontario host organizations after de-duplicating season variants, though several records carry visible 2019-2020 program dates so treat as 'on file', not confirmed currently active.
3. EOBA (via TeamSnap Tournaments, events.teamsnap.com/events/45924): PUBLIC once an Origin+Referer header pair is sent to the backing tournaments-api.teamsnap.com API (Cloudflare 403s without them, 200s with them -- no cookies/auth needed). 31 clubs vs. the 16 previously known, including a likely correction (OSS and OSBA are probably two separate clubs, not one as previously merged) and an upgrade (bare 'Belleville' -> 'Belleville Spirits').
4. Hoop City Basketball League (tourneymachine.com/R180786): PUBLIC -- the earlier 403/hang was just a missing desktop User-Agent + networkidle timing out on persistent ad connections, not a real block. 32 clubs vs. the 3 previously known (confirmed Gators->'Gators Elite' and V3 Basketball active; did not find 'P13 Academy' this season). Standout: 'GBA' fields 14+ coach-named teams, by far the largest program, full name unconfirmed.
5. TCBL / J17 Basketball: SCOPE CORRECTION -- tcbl.ca is an ADULT rec pickup league (day-of-week leagues, pun team names), confirmed via its own API there is no separate 'J17 Kids' league object. J17 Basketball (j17basketball.com) is a single Markham-based club/facility with its own rep teams (U9-U17), not a multi-club directory -- 1 club record.
6. Canada Hoops Circuit: PARTIAL. Site itself is fully public and confirms 6 operator/host clubs (F.O.R.M., CanElite-4QT, Windsor Suns Elite, Jr. Lancers, ACE Basketball, Golden Ticket Basketball Club), but the site explicitly states actual participating-team rosters/standings only exist on Instagram (@canadahoopscircuit), where the post grid is genuinely login-gated (profile header is public, posts are not) -- not bypassed. 'Toronto Nationals' in the task brief = the Nationals event location, not a team name; no such team found.
7. Kingdom Summer League (Toronto): NOT FOUND. The exact handle given (@kingdomsummerleague on Instagram/Threads/Facebook, all rendered without a login wall) is confirmed to be the Columbus, Ohio league the task said to exclude (Bruce Thornton/Ohio State content, Canal Winchester vs Westland, Columbus-area schools). kingdomsummerleague.com/.ca don't resolve (DNS NXDOMAIN); 7 plausible alternate Instagram handles and multiple web searches found no distinct Toronto league. Reported honestly as not found rather than substituting the wrong league's data. 0 clubs.
8. Toronto Big League (torontobigleague.ca): PUBLIC and now fully alive (task's baseline said it refused all connections) -- a Vaadin SPA whose /standings route is directly public (no login) across 4 divisions (JR/SR Prep, JR/SR Rep). 42 distinct clubs, several cross-confirmed against other sources in this sweep (Brockville Blazers vs. EOBA; V3/Time 2 Hoop/Jaxx City Elite/Tru Balance vs. Hoop City League; CALI Prep -- the exact club the task itself used as its worked naming example). The old basketball.exposureevents.com/221944 link is confirmed dead (plain 404 today).

Cross-source corroboration is a notable secondary finding: several clubs (V3 Basketball, Time 2 Hoop, Jaxx City Elite, Tru Balance, Brockville Blazers, YAAACE, Canada Elite, Downtown Finest/Downtown's Finest) independently show up in 2 or more of these otherwise-unrelated league sources, giving good confidence these are real, currently-active Ontario clubs rather than one-off registrations.

Genuinely dead or gated (reported honestly, not bypassed): OBA Registered Teams (broken vendor TLS, not a bot block), Canada Hoops Circuit's Instagram post grid (real login wall), Kingdom Summer League Toronto (no findable web presence distinct from the unrelated Columbus league).
